versions.content: The "Max data size" bytes are only supported if the configuration parameter DoIPEntityStatusMaxByteFieldUse is set to TRUE. In this case, the diag- nostic entity status response message shall contain the configured DoIPMaxRequest Bytes in the "Max data size" field.
